visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A group of approximately six people is descending a modern staircase with warm wooden walls and bright ceiling spotlights. They are elaborately dressed in Qing Dynasty-style costumes; one woman leads in a vibrant pink robe with a large floral headdress, while a man follows in a light blue robe and matching hat. (2) A close-up shot focuses on the man in the blue costume, who is speaking directly toward the camera with animated facial expressions while walking. The lighting shifts to cooler, fluorescent tones as they transition between indoor spaces. (3) Several members of the group are seen inside a public bus at night, sitting in the blue seats. The woman in the pink costume smiles broadly, holding a smartphone with a custom case. (4) The scene shifts to a bustling night street with bright neon signage and streetlights. The group walks along the sidewalk in their historical attire, laughing and gesturing toward the camera. (5) Inside a KTV room with purple and green ambient lighting, the woman in pink performs on a small stage, holding a microphone and dancing rhythmically while others record her with their phones.

Other voices in the background cheer and shout phrases like 'Ge Ge Ji Xiang.' (3) The acoustic environment shifts to include the resonant reverb of a KTV room. A series of pop songs follow in a medley. The female singer's voice is dominant, characterized by clear articulation and high valence. narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To document and share a humorous and celebratory birthday event where a group of friends, including Taiwanese celebrity Gui Gui (Wu Yingjie), dressed in Qing Dynasty costumes to travel through modern Taipei and go to karaoke.
